headline: Jensen Huang Posts On X For The First Time Ever — And Uses It To Defend Open-Source AI
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defends open-source AI in first post, saying it strengthens safety, cybersecurity, and innovation.

headline: Meta, Microsoft, Palantir, Nvidia and 21 Others Sign Letter Backing Open-Weight AI Models

headline: Why Is ServiceNow Stock Surging On Friday?
